author: Stuarts
body:
Hello there fellow avicus members ,
I bring you a new map that I worked on in only an afternoon so obviously I kept it simple.
For once I didn't overdecorate and focused more on good gameplay , so I'm hoping this map will be apreciated !

Author: {tag=1154d26dfa5d4c429a38aa3506d6ac7e}     

Images :                                                            

https://imgur.com/a/4vFC4

Map/XML :

gave it to the mvp devs alredy ;u


So as you can see this map is pretty simple to strategize on.
Although the map might seem small , I estimate that it could incorporate a capacity of 22 Players per Team.

Theses teams are :

- Orange [needs to capture Pink/Red wool from Red team's side]
- Red      [needs to capture Yellow/Orange wool from Orange team's side]

I hope this map is able to pull off good opinions from others in terms of gameplay , proving that simple can also be good.


Constructive criticism is always apreciated <3

replies.author: Stuarts
replies.body: Well I know that people might think I chose theses colors to be "original" , but the truth is that I plan on using the "tron" color scheme for later , better maps . I also chose theses colors as they are modest and fit the stoney vibe . If I'm to ever make anything neon with bright blue , green ect... it will be on a much better map :D
